'''Adam Peabody''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Greeley tournament]] on 12 October 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3063">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-18-greeley-10-12-01-dirty-popd3063/ greeley-10-12-01-dirty-pop], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 18 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-18-greeley-10-12-01-dirty-popd3063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
